content.short: TokenPocket is a leading self-custodial multi-chain wallet supporting Mantle and 30+ blockchains with an integrated DeFi browser and swap aggregator.
content.description: TokenPocket is one of the most widely used self-custodial cryptocurrency wallets in the world, with over 20 million users across more than 200 countries. The wallet supports Mantle and over 30 other blockchain networks, providing users with a comprehensive interface for managing assets, interacting with dApps through a built-in Web3 browser, and swapping tokens through an integrated aggregator. TokenPocket is particularly popular in Asia and is one of the recommended wallets for the Mantle ecosystem.
content.meta: TokenPocket is a leading multi-chain self-custodial wallet with DeFi tools supporting Mantle and 30+ chains. Discover TokenPocket on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
